# SINAIGROUP-AI

> Governed AI and AI Decision Assurance for high-stakes decisions.

SINAIGROUP-AI designs the governed decision layer around existing AI, models and agents. The focus is evidence provenance, premise verification, counter-evidence, Human Acceptance Authority, permitted action boundaries, evaluation and auditable decision records.

## Commercial truth

- No signed client contracts are claimed.
- No production deployments are claimed.
- No certifications are claimed.
- Pre-contract technical work is labelled as such.
- Architecture and methodology pages may describe reference designs rather than deployed systems.

## Primary pages

- [AI Decision Assurance](https://www.sinaigroup-ai.com/ai-decision-assurance/)

- [Critical Infrastructure](https://www.sinaigroup-ai.com/critical-infrastructure/)
- [Home](https://www.sinaigroup-ai.com/)

## Core decision path

Evidence -> Model / AI / Agent -> Premise Verification -> Counter-Evidence -> Evaluation -> Human Acceptance Authority -> Permitted Action Boundary -> Action -> Governed Decision Record -> Outcome / Learning

## Boundaries

SINAIGROUP-AI does not claim regulatory certification, legal advice, guaranteed compliance, guaranteed model performance, or transfer of business authority to AI.
